objective_contribution: Test a reusable evidence/process separation for ARE while finishing GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench qualification under cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does separating durable receipt-bound evidence from exploratory process history remove task-dependent harm while preserving useful GLM-5.3-flash continuity at 8K?

measurement_mapping.native: All eight paired native ContextBench span and file metrics measure evidence-selection usefulness; they do not prove patch correctness.
measurement_mapping.retention: Exactly one evidence-only presentation per recycled treatment generation establishes exposure; native improvement is required for useful-retention support.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Check projection mode, absence of outcome leakage, evidence bindings, generation/request identity, source credit, correction, usage, arm parity, and terminal effects.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input and output tokens for every successful, failed, corrective, recovery, state, and terminal request; unknown usage invalidates the experiment decision.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Evidence/process separation is designed as a cross-domain mechanism, but one exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K run cannot establish transfer, semantic retention, correctness, larger windows, or confirmation.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or other domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through twelve and these eight development identities are exposed; reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, task replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold/mechanism change, or lucky rerun. Retain all outcomes and pause on shared failure.

retained_counterevidence: Round 12 completed all 16 cells with exact one-shot delivery but only six complete native pairs.
Round 12 complete-pair mean state-minus-control span F1 was -0.0021946923387415607 against +0.05.
Round 12 state used 352,655 model tokens, 4,505 more than control.
State helped tasks 1, 2 and 4, tied task 5, harmed tasks 6 and 8, and left tasks 3 and 7 unscored.
Descriptive trace counts did not yield a valid pre-treatment gate; post-treatment counts cannot serve as causal selectors.
Native evidence selection remains distinct from semantic retention and repair correctness.
successor_rule: Freeze H23 only after v3 continuity, component verification, full tests, matched design, tokenizer-only preflight, and exact source closure pass. Run each frozen cell once. Review all results against unchanged acceptance. Any successor must again carry the enduring objective, initial GLM objective, current milestone, exact method chain, and retained counterevidence.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The plan targets reusable ARE continuity, recovery, correctness-oriented completion, and cumulative model-token efficiency.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: The plan explicitly keeps GLM-5.3-flash and the 8K small-window-first order.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench contract remains uncleared; this exposed development round cannot clear it.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The exact ontology chain starts from the reviewed Round 12 result and tests H23 against H20 and H0.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Round 12 missing pairs, aggregate miss, token increase, and positive/negative task effects are retained.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, retention exposure, integrity, correctness limits, transfer limits, and all model input/output tokens remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The cohort remains separate from confirmation, larger windows, SWE-bench, other models, and transfer claims.
criterion_verdicts.testability: H23 changes one projection component and fixes eight pairs, native/validity/token/integrity gates, and stopping rules.
